title: Cultural and typographic AI evaluation kit
summary: How can evaluators separate factual cultural/typographic constraint failures from subjective aesthetic preference, while documenting disagreement and source provenance?
evidence_level: Measured check self-consistency on template artifacts; no model or rater results
contribution: Ilghar Dadgostari: problem framing, requirements and evaluation direction. Implementation AI-assisted (Grok Bot), reviewed only by Grok Bot so far.
architecture: Separate factual and aesthetic rubric axes
Versioned evaluation report and design examples

results.metric: automated check detection of generated corruptions
false positives on clean template artifacts

limitations: No human annotations; aesthetic axes unmeasured.
C03/C04 are human-review-only; text checks cannot see font shaping.
